questions.q: Which jersey does the overall leader of the Tour de France wear?
questions.e: The maillot jaune matched the newsprint of L'Auto.

questions.q: What colour is the leader's jersey at the Giro d'Italia?
questions.e: The maglia rosa reflects the pink pages of La Gazzetta dello Sport.

questions.q: Which jersey leads the Vuelta a Espana?
questions.e: La roja has been used since 2010.

questions.q: What does the polka dot jersey signify at the Tour de France?
questions.e: It is awarded to the King of the Mountains.

questions.q: What does the green jersey reward at the Tour de France?
questions.e: Points come from stage finishes and intermediate sprints.

questions.q: How long does a Grand Tour normally last?
questions.e: Around 21 stages with two rest days.

questions.q: Which climb is the Tour de France's most famous hairpin ascent?
questions.e: It has 21 numbered hairpin bends.

questions.q: Where does the Tour de France traditionally finish?
questions.e: The final stage is usually ceremonial until the sprint.

categories.name: Racing & Tactics
categories.blurb: How a bike race is won

questions.q: What is the peloton?
questions.e: Riding in the bunch saves significant energy.

questions.q: What is drafting?
o: Riding closely behind another to reduce wind resistance
questions.e: It can cut effort by roughly a third.

questions.q: What is a domestique?
o: A rider who works for the team leader
questions.e: They fetch bottles, shelter the leader and chase attacks.

questions.q: What is a time trial?
o: A race against the clock ridden individually or as a team
questions.e: Riders start at intervals with no drafting allowed.

questions.q: What is a breakaway?
o: A small group riding clear of the peloton
questions.e: Breakaways often form early on hilly stages.

questions.q: What is the general classification?
questions.e: The lowest total time leads the race.

questions.q: What are the cobbled one-day races in Belgium and France known as?
questions.e: Paris-Roubaix is the most famous cobbled Classic.

questions.q: What is a criterium?
o: A short race on a closed circuit
questions.e: Popular for city-centre racing.

questions.q: What is a velodrome?
questions.e: Olympic tracks are 250 metres long.

questions.q: What is the Hour Record?
o: The furthest distance ridden in one hour
questions.e: It is set on a velodrome under strict rules.

questions.q: Which track event involves riders starting on opposite sides and pursuing each other?
questions.e: Catching the opponent ends the race.

questions.q: What paces riders in a keirin race before the sprint?
questions.e: The derny pulls away with a few laps to go.

questions.q: Which Belgian rider is often called the greatest of all time?
questions.e: Merckx won all three Grand Tours and every Monument.

questions.q: Which body governs international cycling?
questions.e: The Union Cycliste Internationale.

questions.q: Which nation has been dominant in Olympic track cycling since 2008?
questions.e: British riders won multiple golds across several Games.

questions.q: What does the rainbow jersey signify?
questions.e: It is worn for a year in the discipline it was won.
